propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json from disk and uses field values for drift classification; narrowing prev to key-set entries with empty dicts would silently degrade classification accuracy

The drift classification in bridge_fsck.py:306-308 and :344/:380 depends on field values but receives only membership information when prev_snapshot is narrowed, causing false or missing drift reports
Absent fields should be reported as indeterminate classification rather than inferred from empty dict entries to avoid silent false-negatives in drift detection

Field-dependent classifications (terminal-local, PRESENT status) must be fenced to handle key-set fixtures, while membership-only cases (active-bound, missing-local, unbound-present) remain unaffected
rebar bridge-fsck CLI exit code and JSON output shape must remain unchanged and consistent between key-set and full-payload fixtures
